body: Opus2 send-verification trap (2026-11-13): never re-send a GO with the same idempotency key just to check whether it was delivered. If the first send silently failed, the re-send DELIVERS it now, possibly after it went stale (this happened with GO-S4-ENGRAM-AB27-R4-FULL-1: first send at 16:17Z never reached s4, a 16:23Z delivery check re-sent the superseded GO, and an immediate withdrawal was needed). To verify delivery, read the recipient mailbox with `mailbox read --mailbox-id <id> --after <latestSequence-N>` and look for your own message (own sends are listed). Also never truncate send-one.sh output below ~40 characters: `head -c 12` hid the rc=/duplicate fields that would have shown the failure.
